ceiling_directive: Complete the latent-free analytic characterization of the terminal body for every three-plan pure-entry and pure-exit class, including all sign and zero-probability boundary cases, and provide explicit attaining mixtures.
improvement_directive: Execute the active-allocation elimination beginning with negative entry when both off-diagonal probabilities are positive, verify its support function against all twenty two-patch curves, and then derive complete Boolean inequality formulas and constructive rationalizations for the remaining entry and six exit classes.
critique: The note proves a sharp finite-response conditional-iid representation, eventual stabilization after finitely many price breakpoints, the finite-ceiling iff criterion, and certified approximation and inference, but it does not deliver the stipulated non-generic three-plan analytic body. In particular, negative and zero-sign entry cases and all six exit classes remain open, so the advertised turnover frontier is available only through latent quadratic mixtures, semialgebraic feasibility, or approximation rather than the explicit observable inequalities that would distinguish the contribution from generic sharp-set computation. Exact endpoint recovery for arbitrary real tables is also only relative to an exact-real oracle, which limits the operational force of the claimed finite search. The framing discloses this gap rather than falsely asserting completion, but the missing analytic kernel leaves the delivered result as a useful specialized framework rather than a field-tier resolution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.4 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
